Any headaches or changes in your vision?
Are you taking the lisinopril every day?

Yes, the morning is fine. Keep taking it at the same time each day.

Good. I'll keep checking my blood pressure at home too.

Okay, losartan is fine with that. Call us if the cough gets worse or you feel faint. Let's recheck your blood pressure in four weeks.
